en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They were reporting that the charity, by it the injustices are repelled from the man’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father, from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘They (reliable people) were of the opinion that by giving charity, a man saves himself from suffering injustice.’”
